sources.title: Los efectos del salario mínimo interprofesional en el empleo: nueva evidencia para España (DO 2113)
sources.why: Low-wage workers' employment grew more slowly after 2019 rise; hours fell.

sources.title: Impacto de la subida del SMI en 2017 sobre la probabilidad de perder el empleo (DO 1902)
sources.why: Ex-ante basis for BdE's ~125k job-loss estimate for 2019.

sources.title: Employment effects of the minimum wage: evidence from the Spanish 2019 reform
sources.why: Peer-reviewed: +1.7 pp unemployment risk for treated, elasticity -0.08.

sources.title: Evaluating the impact of the large 2019 increase in the Spanish minimum wage on job retention and employment
sources.why: Finds no adverse effects on job retention or employment.

sources.title: GLO DP 1533 (Christl, Cubells Enguídanos, di Pietro) on 2019 Spanish minimum wage
sources.why: No significant effect on low-skilled outcomes; some price increases.

sources.title: Youth employment and the 2019 Spanish minimum wage increase
sources.why: Concludes no aggregate youth employment losses.

sources.title: Systematic review of 34 studies on minimum wage (14 on Spain 2019)
sources.why: Review: wage gains, less inequality, no substantial employment losses.

sources.title: AIReF ex-post estimate of SMI 2019 impact (press)
sources.why: Press on AIReF: 19-33k fewer affiliates in 2019; find AIReF PDF.
